verdict.rationale: Zamzar documents a public REST API with sandbox and production endpoints, Bearer/Basic API-key auth, a `jobs` endpoint for driving conversions, format-discovery responses, credit headers, an official Java SDK and tested code samples, so the product can be driven programmatically. Probes found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec, llms.txt or markdown docs, which limits machine-readable discovery for AI agents. missing for 10: machine-readable OpenAPI spec or LLM-oriented docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.
